name: Engineers in Action
tagline: We're UW students who design footbridges for communities that rivers cut off, and then we travel to build them with the people who will use them.
footerLine: Footbridges designed by UW students and built with the communities that use them.
purpose: Engineers in Action at UW is a student team that designs pedestrian footbridges for rural communities that rivers cut off from schools, clinics, and markets. We spend the school year on design, fundraising, and planning, and then a group of us travels to build the bridge with the community.
heroImageAlt: The EIA UW team on a finished footbridge

sponsorUses.title: Materials
sponsorUses.text: Cable, steel, cement, and lumber make up most of what a footbridge costs.

sponsorUses.title: Travel
sponsorUses.text: Flights, lodging, and local transport get the student build team to the community and back.

sponsorUses.title: Tools and safety gear
sponsorUses.text: We buy hand tools, harnesses, and site safety equipment for each build and reuse them on later trips.

sponsorBenefits: We put your logo on this site and in our sponsorship materials.
You can recruit from a team of UW engineering students who have designed and built real infrastructure.
We send you photos and updates from the build trip that you can share with your own team.
